profile.dividendPolicy: Not less than 40% of net profit after tax, legal reserves, and as required by company regulations. The dividend payment is based on factors such as operational performance, liquidity, working capital requirement, investment plans, business expansion plans, market condition, suitability, and relevant considerations, including future business management of the company and its subsidiaries. The annual dividend payments require approval from the shareholders' meeting, except for interim dividends. The board of directors has the authority to approve interim dividend payments on a temporary basis if they deem it appropriate, without adversely affecting the company's operations. A report on the interim dividend payments will be provided to the shareholders' meeting for their information at the next meeting
